scripts.render:gp: for r in r1-monaco r2-silverstone r3-spa r4-suzuka r5-monza; do remotion render GP-$r "${VIDEO_OUT:-$HOME/GoogleCloud}/$r.mp4"; done
scripts.tower:sweep: for s in $(seq 1 20); do node scripts/tower.mjs $s --quiet | grep -E "seed|DNF|margin|  1\\." | tr "\n" " "; echo; done
scripts.render:tower: remotion render MarbleRace "${VIDEO_OUT:-$HOME/GoogleCloud}/marble-race.mp4" && remotion render MarbleRaceVertical "${VIDEO_OUT:-$HOME/GoogleCloud}/marble-race-vertical.mp4"
scripts.factory:stop: kill $(cat out/factory/loop.pid 2>/dev/null) 2>/dev/null || pkill -TERM -f 'scripts/factory.mjs --season' || echo 'nothing to stop'
